1.01A.headline: DELTARUNE Hotfix Patch (PC&Mac) v1.01A
1.01A.body:
We are releasing a hotfix for PC&Mac to remedy some issues occurring in the game.
You can confirm the version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.
[b]
Changelist[/b]

[b]Ch3 v.0.0.087[/b]
Fixed a common crash in a room with a lot of screens.
Fixed a crash when a certain boss tries to summon enemies.
Fixed a freeze involving talking to a character after getting off of a raft.
Fixed a freeze when checking binoculars.
Removed a visible debug message.
Fixed a crash involving picking up grass and swapping characters frame perfectly.
Fixed a part where you can erroneously enter an empty room.
Backtracking to a puzzle after attaining a special armor no longer crashes the game.
Added a failsafe if you don't have audio output during rhythm games segments.

[b]Ch4 v.0.0.086[/b]
Fixed an issue where pressing up on the keyboard was required to move out of a present, regardless of key binding.
Small graphical alteration to a certain scene.

[i]We are aware of many other remaining issues, so we will be issuing another patch soon! After everything is hotfixed on PC, we will patch consoles next (it takes longer).[/i]

1.01B.headline: DELTARUNE Hotfix Patch (PC & Mac) v1.01B
1.01B.body:
[b]DELTARUNE Hotfix Patch (PC & Mac) v1.01B[/b]

We are releasing a hotfix for PC & Mac to remedy some issues occurring in the game.
You can confirm the version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.
[b]
Changelist[/b]

[b]Ch3 v.0.0.088[/b]
Fixed a softlock where you can get teleported to the Green Room during the battle with one of the final bosses, and be permanently unable to progress if you save. (This fix prevents the issue from happening again, but unfortunately if you had this bug occur, your save file will still be broken.)

Fixed a softlock where the raft could get stuck in a wall.

Fixed a crash if you lose to the first miniboss with zero points.

Fixed a depth issue with a black tile.
 
Some players' computers are not compatible with the method of video display in Chapter 3. if you reach a cinematic which crashes or freezes your game, returning to that scene once more will give you the option to skip it.

Fixed a bug when receiving a prize for attaining the highest rank.

After defeating a certain a boss, if your inventory is too full to receive the armor in the chest,  a treasure chest will be placed into the Green Room.



[b]Ch4 v.0.0.087[/b]

Fixed an issue where the game would crash when loading a file from Chapter 3.

Fixed a crash with a scene that could happen at the end of an area.

Fixed an issue of trapped in the closet.



We are aware of many other remaining issues, so we will be issuing one last hotfix patch soon! After the next hotfix is on PC, we will generate a patch for consoles.

1.01C.headline: DELTARUNE Hotfix Patch (PC & Mac) v1.01C
1.01C.body:
We are releasing a hotfix for PC & Mac to remedy some issues occurring in the game.
You can confirm the version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

[b]Changelist[/b]
[b]
Ch3 v.0.0.089[/b]

Fixed crashes relating to Shadowguy's Sharpshoot ACT.

[b]
Ch4 v.0.0.088[/b]

Removed key combinations that caused various issues across the game.

Fixed a crash relating to talking to an NPC when it's raining.

Strengthened an imagery while while maintaining the scene's intended meaning.

Fix of trapped out the closet.


[i]We will begin the process of issuing the previous patch (1.01B) to consoles soon (not that that matters to you guys). The next patch will take longer and address non-fatal bugs. After that, we will take some more time to consider other adjustments.[/i]

1.02.headline: DELTARUNE Patch 1.02
1.02.body:
[b]DELTARUNE v1.02 Patch[/b]

We have issued a new bugfix patch for all platforms (PC / Mac / Consoles). After updating, you can check the version numbers in the bottom right of the file select screen for each respective chapter.

[b]Version Numbers[/b]
Ch1 1.37
Ch2 1.43
Ch3 v0.0.091
Ch4 v0.0.090

[b]Changelist[/b]

[b]Chapter 2[/b]
・Fixed an issue in the room with fireworks where the floor switch can be pressed by an invisible character.

[b]Chapter 3[/b]
・Key Items received from the Ball Machine no longer incorrectly persist outside of that room. This caused numerous issues, including not being able to receive the Shadow Crystal from a certain boss.
・Fixed an issue where Susie and Ralsei would appear completely shadowed if defeated by a boss's attack.
・In a room where Susie destroys houses, she no longer stops moving erroneously after the battle. However, she now slides around erroneously. Apparently this is better.
・Attempted to fix issues on Board 1 where you can see duplicate Ralseis as well as make Ralsei disappear indefinitely.

[b]Chapter 4[/b]
・Fixed some places where the characters were the normal color in an area that has abnormal coloration.
・Fixed an issue where it's possible to get temporarily stuck in a playable piano.
・Fixed an issue during an optional battle where damage numbers done to the players were not visible. Additionally, the heal numbers were moving further to the right every time they appeared.
・Removed the erroneous appearance of a duplicate Kris in the closet.
・[PC-only] Fixed various display issues with the microphone select menu. Additionally, fixed a potential softlock if you have no microphones attached.

[b]All Chapters[/b]
・"Master Volume" setting now persists between Chapters when using the same file.
・[PC-only] Fixed the way the controllers are handled to alleviate some issues with TV-docked Steam Decks.
・[Mac-only] Fixed an issue on certain Mac systems where the full-screen mode would resize improperly when returning to the main menu from Chapter 4.
・Additionally, there are several other minor aesthetic fixes across chapters 2, 3, and 4.

Testing of the next patch (1.03) has already been completed and is waiting for release. The next two patches contain many more crash and softlock fixes, as well as some extremely slight adjustments to gameplay.

1.03.headline: DELTARUNE Patch 1.03
1.03.body:
[b]DELTARUNE v1.03 Patch[/b]

We have issued a new bugfix patch for all platforms (PC / Mac / Consoles). After updating, you can check the version numbers in the bottom right of the file select screen for each respective chapter.

[b]Version Numbers[/b]
ch1: 1.38
ch2: 1.44
ch3: v0.0.094
ch4: v0.0.094

[b]Changelist[/b]

[b]Chapter 3[/b]
・Swords used in a certain boss's "Sword Tunnel" attack now have a reduced hit box relative to the graphic, making the attack easier to dodge.
・Fixed a softlock on the Board 1 that could occur after using only three keys.
・Fixed a soft lock if a party member fails to reach the Power Croissant.
・Fixed a crash if you pushed a pyramid the wrong way.
・Fixed an issue where on certain platforms, the sprites of the game would become blurry after the Tenna scene.
・[PC-only] Fixed a visual issue where after defeating Tenna, it was erroneously showing texture data instead of static on certain computers.

[b]Chapter 4[/b]
・If you lose to Jackenstein 2 times in a row,  the amount of damage that the chasing pumpkin deals will be halved. If you lose 3 times in a row, TP gain will be increased by 50%. These changes will allow players who find this battle difficult to progress past it more easily.
・Fixed a softlock which could occur if the tutu was not returned to you.
・Fixed an issue where normal battle music would not play if you fought Mike at the beginning of the game. (This issue becomes resolved after fighting Jackenstein.)
・Fixed an issue with a hitbox not working when a boss dives at you from many different directions. (The hitbox will be adjusted more later)
・Fixed an impossible note on the song "Knock You Down!!" in the rhythm game.
・Fixed an issue where Kris would still appear to be wearing their church clothes even though they'd been removed.
・Fixed an issue where asking Ralsei advice for a puzzle would simply result in him saying a single button.
・Fixed an issue where changing octaves on the giant piano organ thing could freeze the game.
・Susie and Ralsei no longer erroneously appear in the rhythm game at Castle Town at the end of the Chapter.

[b]Various Chapters[/b]
・Fixed an issue where the intro prophecy would always be skipped after selecting a chapter using a controller.
・Fixed a few minor textual errors.
・Fixed various minor graphical errors.
・Various other minor fixes.

--

Testing of the next patch (1.04) has already been mostly completed and will be submitted soon. The next patch contains a minor gameplay adjustment in addition to various fixes.

1.04.headline: DELTARUNE Patch 1.04
1.04.body:
[b]DELTARUNE v1.04 Patch[/b]

We have issued a new bugfix patch for all platforms (PC / Mac / Consoles). After updating, you can check the version numbers in the bottom right of the file select screen for each respective chapter.

[b]Version Numbers[/b]
ch1: 1.40
ch2: 1.46
ch3: v0.0.098
ch4: v0.0.098

[b]Changelist[/b]

[b]Chapter 3[/b]
・Added a method to get "TripTicket" even after receiving "ShadowMantle".
・You can no longer erroneously keep Lancers in your inventory.
・Susie doesn't slide weird after battle in that room where she kicks the houses. Apparently this is better.
・Fixed an obscure softlock during the Pushing Buddies sequence.
・Fixed a frame perfect game crash if you throw a shell and check it as it's breaking.
・Fixed a frame perfect crash involving checking water-logged binoculars.

[b]Chapter 4[/b]
・You can get the "SpinCake" from the "Top Chef" if you gave him the "TopCake" in the "Chapter1".
・Reduced the speed of the bullets on one of Jackenstein's attacks.
・Fixed an obscure issue if you used "OldMan" ACT and then spared Guei before the attack started.
・Toriel no longer answers the phone at the beginning of the Chapter.
・You can no longer check a nonexistent snack tray.
・Fixed an error where "DualHeal" ACT could be skipped in certain scenarios.
・Fixed an error where Susie's turn would be skipped if she used an item during the boss of the Second Sanctuary.

[b]Various Chapters[/b]
・Fixed various minor visual errors.
・Fixed minor text and font issues.
・Fixed an issue where your customized keyboard controls could be reset when connecting a new controller.
・Fixed an issue where plugging in USB and Bluetooth controllers simultaneously could cause repetitive button presses.

The next patch (1.05) only contains extremely minor changes, but internally it contains some large code changes, so we will be initially releasing it on a Steam beta branch soon.

0.0.241.headline: DELTARUNE Chapter 5 Hotfix Patch (Chapter 5 Version 0.0.241)
0.0.241.body:
We have released a quick update to fix a few issues with the game.
You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.
[b]
DELTARUNE Chapter 5 Version 0.0.241 for PC/Mac[/b]

- Fixed an issue where, towards the end of a boss, when the music becomes slow, flirting would softlock the game.
- Fixed a softlock when pressing Z&X simultaneously when interacting with a disappearing fox. Also fixed another bug in the same scenario.
- Fixed a crash when knives spawn from an aqua-colored enemy, and after said enemy is defeated.
- Fixed a crash when collecting candy from a green-colored enemy.
- Fixed a situation where Kris could be gigantic and the game was unplayable if you had modified your save file in a previous Chapter.
- The last boss of the chapter becomes gradually easier after losing an excessive amount of times in one play session.

We will continue to address bugs as quickly as we can.
Thank you for you playing, and for your patience with these issues!

0.0.242.headline: Chapter 5 Version 0.0.242 (Hotfix Patch)
0.0.242.body:
Another quick fix for some bugs some players were encountering.

• Fixed a crash towards the end of the game in an area with a yellow guy in the background.
• Fixed a crash involving a small glove.
• Fixed a crash when encountering a leaf enemy while leaving a room.
• Opening a pink door at a precise location no longer makes the screen go black.
• Magical glass was placed over a wall you're not supposed to go over.
• Using Rudebuster in the final phase of a pink enemy no longer crashes the game.
• Fixed a crash if you put Ralsei in your party before sleeping in bed to skip the intro.
• Fixed a crash when Trashy Trio are defeated.
• Fixed a memory leak which could crash the game if certain actions were repeated an excessive number of times.

We are aware of other issues and are working to fix them! Thank you so much to everyone that has reported anything so far.

0.0.243.headline: Chapter 5 Version 0.0.243 (Hotfix Patch)
0.0.243.body:
Hey guys, one more small patch here. As we seem to have covered many common crashes and softlocks, we'll be taking our time with the next patches.

- Fixed a bug where losing to the last boss of the chapter, leaving the area without saving, then getting a game over elsewhere would result in the file failed to load (dogcheck) screen.
- Fixed a crash in a room where you can spend Pink Coins.
- Attempted a fix for a crash when lyrics are displayed onscreen.
- Fixed a softlock when entering a room where you are blown upwards by wind, without dashing.
- Fixed a softlock where a large yellow gun could move offscreen forever.
- Fixed a softlock where a giant pair of glasses could become invincible forever.
- Fixed a softlock in a certain Festival after talking to the guy who regrets buying round things, saving, then reloading the game, then talking again.
- Added a failsafe to the scissor cutting ACT where the ACT will end automatically if enough time passes without initially moving.
- Sprites no longer disappear when trying to put your hands in the grape I mean eyeball bowl.

0.0.247.headline: DELTARUNE Chapter 5 v0.0.247 Patch
0.0.247.body:
[p]Today we released an update for PC/Mac to fix a few issues with the game.
You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

Changelist

Chapter 5 Version 0.0.247

GAME CHANGES
・You will no longer receive JusticeAxe from the hole in the CastleTown cliff if you never got the
　Shadow Crystal in Chapter 4 on that file slot.
・Grazing the bullets of an aqua miniboss no longer erroneously makes the attacks last longer.
・Fixed an error where the bread-smashing time attack wouldn't display a 0 digit correctly.
・Fixed an error where an armor that is supposed to increase the amount of invincibility frames did
　not work against the chapter boss.
・Fixed various memory leaks, which seem to have been causing random crashes on Playstation 4.
・Fixed a softlock where you can clip through the floor after defeating certain platforming encounters.
・Fixed a softlock when using Rude Buster in the first phase of the platforming battle before the
　chapter boss.
・Fixed an error where scissors would no longer be damaging after an event.
・Fixed the SOUL visually remaining in the birdcage if the Chapter's first scene was skipped in a
　certain way.
・Fixed various circumstances where two textboxes can overlap, or where you can walk around with
　the menu still open.
・Fixed train blueprints hovering in the air, and various other minor graphical fixes.
・Various other minor fixes.

TEXT CHANGES
・The shop in the Cliffs has new dialogue in an extremely obscure circumstance.
・Credits have been added for the following people:
　　Matt Cummings – Festival Concept Art
　　Zu Ehtisham – Platforming VFX
　　Marcy Nabors – Music Assistance
・The manual in Castle Town now mentions Susie's SCYTHEMARE.
・Various minor fixes.

CLARIFICATION OF PREVIOUS PATCH NOTES
A modification to the chapter boss which makes the battle easier was mentioned recently.
To be clear, this battle only becomes extremely slightly easier each time the player loses from 6 times 
to a maximum of 16 times in a single gameplay session. If you lose to the boss 5 times or less, this 
change has no effect on you, and even losing to him 6 or 7 times has so little of an effect that the 
average player would not notice a meaningful difference.


We will continue to address issues as quickly as we can.

Thank you for your patience and for playing the game![/p]

0.0.250.headline: DELTARUNE Chapter 5 v0.0.250 Patch
0.0.250.body:
Today we released an update for PC/Mac and PlayStation to fix a few issues with the game.
You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

[b]Changelist[/b]

[b]Chapter 5 Version 0.0.250[/b]

[b]GAMEPLAY ADDITIONS[/b]
・A Golden Tenna Statue will now appear in Castle Town in Chapter 5 if you got it from the Ball Machine in Chapter 3.
・The ability to permanently re-enable Voice Clips has been shoddily added if you lose to the Chapter Boss and have them disabled.

[b]GAMEPLAY ISSUES[/b]
・In Chapter 4, defeating a Titan Spawn with violence no longer erroneously counts as "Lost". We also fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where Jackenstein would not appear in your town because of this.
・Susie now has additional magic points in Chapter 5 if you defeated the Shadow Crystal boss of Chapter 4.
・Fixed some issues where the number on the TP display was occasionally inaccurate.
・You can no longer incorrectly leave a certain scene by frame-perfectly opening the menu in the Light World.
・Fixed an issue where on gamepads, ZL / L2 would count only as a single frame press of confirm in Chapter 5 only.
・Fixed an issue involving bugged blank item slots which had been carried over from Chapter 4 save files before it was fixed in that chapter.
・Fixed an issue where you can clip through the floor after fighting three scarecrows by immediately opening the ACT menu, and other bugs involving the ACT menu.
・You can no longer crash the game by hitting an enemy and a Mysterious Statue at the same time. (Unless you can)
・You can no longer walk around during combat by interacting with Final Starwalker on the same frame you engage a battle. (And other similar issues)
・Fixed various scenarios where you can move around with the menu open.
・Fixed certain bullet patterns not giving TP when grazed.
・Kris will no longer stay sideways if you enter into the final cutscene of Chapter 5 sideways.
・Fixed MANY other minor issues, visual or otherwise.

[b]NEXT TIME[/b]
In the next patch, we will add an option to nerf the bombs of the Shadow Crystal boss after losing to them once. Additionally, we plan to fix a small number of bugs in previous chapters which had gone unaddressed up until this point.
There is no plan for another extensive Chapter 5 patch after the next one. Instead, we will resume fully concentrating our development resources on Chapter 6 and 7.
